record_title: A reciprocal-weight criterion for periodic Paley–Wiener uniqueness
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The theorem is stated for one-dimensional full periodic spectra S=A+Z and uniformly dyadically comparable weights. The negative direction uses all translated blocks A+k. No claim is made for arbitrary irregular weights, higher-dimensional periodic spectra, nonperiodic weak gaps, or stable sampling. The source preprint is very recent, so an unindexed parallel weighted refinement remains possible.
